lcc_original: 上帝說：『我們要造人，按着我們的形像，照我們的樣式來造；讓他們管理海裏的魚、空中的飛鳥，也管理牲口、以及全地、和爬在地上的各樣爬行動物。』
notes: 神(UNV)→上帝(LCC): both explicit renderings of WH0430, SN attached normally (no braces dropped/added).

LCC restructures the image/likeness clause: UNV places 造 AFTER 形像/樣式, while LCC places it BEFORE (我們要造人) and then adds a resumptive 來造 at the clause end. WH06213+WTH8799 placed on the first (syntactically primary) 造; the resumptive 來造 left unannotated.
LCC repeats 管理 as 也管理 to introduce the second list of dominion objects (牲口/全地/爬行動物). Hebrew has one verb WH07287; SN placed on first occurrence only.
昆蟲(UNV)→爬行動物(LCC): different lexical choices for Hebrew רֶמֶשׂ (WH07431, creeping things). WH07431 attached to the full word 爬行動物.
The participial verb הרֹמֵשׂ (creeps, WH07430+WTH8802) is rendered in LCC as 爬在…地上; SN placed directly on 爬, and 地上 tagged with WAH05921+WH0776 for עַל הָאָרֶץ.
一切(UNV)→各樣(LCC): both render Hebrew כֹּל (all/every kind); WAH09002+WAH03605 transferred to 各樣.
牲畜(UNV)→牲口(LCC) and 鳥(UNV)→飛鳥(LCC): lexical substitutions, SN transferred to the LCC synonym.
以及 (connector between 牲口 and 全地) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
